name: WriteTextToFile
label: Write Text to File
description: Writes the given text to the specified file using either Replace or Append mode.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full file path where the text should be written.

fields.name: TextToWrite
fields.label: Text to Write
fields.description: The text content to write to the file.

fields.name: WriteMode
fields.label: Write Mode
fields.description: Specifies the write mode: Append (default) or Overwrite.
